description: Dash displacement R-gate: cast Jet Burst (cast_type dash, dash_distance 10, knockup) and confirm the LIVE player actually moves - position delta in evidence via the dash_impulse log (start/target) plus a before/after dev position, proving the KnockbackComponent impulse displaces a client-authoritative player.
notes: Jet Burst is a self-dash (cast_type dash, dash_distance 10, launch_height 2.5, knockup); test mobs line gives an aim target in front.

R-gate evidence: [MOTM] dash_impulse (start/target/velocity, mechanism=knockback) is logged at cast, and motm dev position is captured in setup (before) and cleanup (after). A large delta between the before/after positions proves the KnockbackComponent impulse actually displaced the live player - the mechanism the prior Velocity.set/setClient path failed to achieve.
DoD: dash displacement R-gate (primitive-status / completion-plan) - player position delta in evidence on a live client.
Relocates to a flatlands platform (open-air, 61x61) first so generated canyon structures do not block the dash and mask horizontal displacement.
